product_label: Southern Machinery SMT Stencil Wiping Rolls

outro.title: SMT Stencil Wiping Rolls
outro.subtitle: Sized for your printer · Southern Machinery

scenes.head:
A clean wipe
between prints
vo: Solder paste left under the stencil ends up on the next board.
Paste left under the stencil ends up on the next board.
The wiping roll in your printer takes it away, dry or with solvent.
The wiping roll takes it away, dry or with solvent.

scenes.head:
Wood pulp +
polyester
vo: Our rolls are a two layer web of natural wood pulp and polyester, bonded by water jets.
Two-layer wood pulp and polyester web, hydroentangled.
It soaks up paste and solvent, sheds almost no lint, and stays strong when wet.
Absorbs paste and solvent, low lint, strong when wet.

scenes.head:
Core x width
x length
vo: A roll size has three numbers: core length, paper width and roll length.
Three numbers: core length x paper width x roll length.
For example four ten by three hundred by ten metres. The core length is set by your printer.
e.g. 410 x 300 mm x 10 m. Core length is set by the printer.

scenes.head:
DEK, MPM, GKG,
Panasonic, Yamaha …
vo: G K G and Desen take a four ten core, D E K five thirty, M P M four fifty five.
GKG / Desen 410 mm core, DEK 530 mm, MPM 455 mm.
Plus Panasonic, Yamaha, Hitachi, EKRA and MINAMI, in widths up to six hundred millimetres.
Also Panasonic, Yamaha, Hitachi, EKRA, MINAMI; widths up to 600 mm.

scenes.head:
The core must
match the drive
vo: The core end must match the drive in your printer: cross slot, straight slot, twelve inner grooves or a paper tube.
Cross slot, straight slot, 12 inner grooves or paper tube.
Send us a photo of your old core end and we match it.
Send a photo of your old core end - we match it.

scenes.head:
Rolls, sheets
and custom sizes
vo: Choose a plain or mesh surface. Rolls are ten metres as standard, some sizes fifteen.
Plain or mesh surface. 10 m standard, some sizes 15 m.
Custom widths and hand wiping sheets are available on request.
Custom widths and 200 x 200 mm sheets on request.

scenes.head: What to send us
vo: To order, send your printer model, the core length and paper width, the core opening, and a photo showing how the old roll sits.
Send printer model, core length, paper width, core opening and a photo of the old roll.
Southern Machinery stencil wiping rolls, sized for the printers on your line.
